subject.title: fix: scope user usage to owner and org

question: After real behavior proof is added, should this PR be the sponsored fix for https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/911 while preserving admin owner-wide user reports unless an org is explicit?
rationale: The code path is an authorization boundary and the diff also touches release-owned notes, so automation should not make the final security and release-note acceptance call.

options.title: Land after proof and release-note handling
options.body: Require redacted live usage proof, remove or explicitly approve the CHANGELOG.md hunk, then merge this narrow authorization fix.

options.title: Narrow the admin/reporting contract first
options.body: Ask for a different admin default or clearer documentation if owner-wide admin usage is not the desired long-term behavior.

options.title: Use a replacement security fix
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if maintainers prefer another implementation for the linked security report.

recommendation.title: Land after proof and release-note handling
recommendation.body: Require redacted live usage proof, remove or explicitly approve the CHANGELOG.md hunk, then merge this narrow authorization fix.
